samples.question: Both cafés want the highest profit. Will they keep prices or both discount?
samples.answer: Both discount. Discounting strictly dominates keeping price for each café: 80 > 60 and 40 > 20. One-shot game; independent choices; each maximizes own payoff.

samples.question: At €10 each, 10 buyers want one ticket each. Only 6 tickets are available. How many buyers miss out?
samples.answer: 4. Ten buyers each want one ticket, six are available, each ticket goes to a distinct buyer. No resale or further supply. The example illustrates shortage at the stated price; it does not infer that the cap caused a change in supply.
